name: opacity-swapy

frames.best_why: All six pastel rows sit in their original order with icons and labels fully readable and nothing floating.

tagline: Pastel icon rows in a narrow list that turns half see-through while dragged.
summary: Six pale tinted rows, each with a coloured line icon and a short benefit title, stacked in a narrow column. Dragging a row drops it to half opacity while the others slide apart to show where it will land.
appearance: A narrow centred column of six rounded rows in pale blue, pink, green, yellow, purple and cyan on black, each with a thin dashed outline, a small coloured icon at the left and a dark medium-weight label.
behaviour: Dragging a row anywhere on its surface lifts it out of the stack at half opacity, and the rows above and below slide apart to open a gap. Releasing settles it into that gap, and the list holds the new order until the page reloads.
demo_content: Benefit labels such as Streamline Operations, Decision Making, Reduce Costs and Future-Proof.
search_phrases: pastel rows you can drag to sort
reorder a vertical list of benefits
draggable list with a faded item
rows that slide apart when dragged
rearrange order by dragging a row
light list on a dark page
use_when: A short list of items should be reordered by dragging the row itself with clear feedback.
avoid_when: Rows are a fixed 384 px wide and the order lives only in page state, so it resets on reload.
customise: No props: the six titles, icons and pastel classes sit in the items array in the file, and the 50 percent drag opacity and fixed width live in the source.
weight_why: Six static rows with a drag handler that only runs while a row is held.

a11y.note: Rows drag only by pointer, with no keyboard route or focus handling, and nothing announces the new order.

issues: The new order is only logged to the console and is lost on reload.
Slots reuse the item id, so slot and item keys collide.
The floating row covers two labels at once while it passes over the stack.
polish_why: Soft pastel rows and clear drag feedback; the dashed outlines barely show and the page is bare.
title: Opacity Swapy Layout
